blocks.html: Plan a drone flight before launch so the aircraft flies your route, perimeter, or survey area on its own.

slides.title: Open Mission Manager
slides.html: From the Home Screen, swipe left to reach Stored Tasks, then open Mission Manager. You can plan here with no UAS connected.

slides.title: Build a Route
slides.html: Pick Route to drop a multi-point path for the aircraft to follow. Tap each point on the map, then tap Save. Existing Route converts an ATAK route the same way.

slides.title: Build a Perimeter
slides.html: Pick Perimeter to fly a closed shape. The aircraft follows the outline and returns to the first waypoint. Tap Save when the shape is set.

slides.title: Build a Survey
slides.html: Pick Survey to cover a whole area with a back-and-forth grid. Set the Task Name and Task Altitude (AGL), then tap Create Task.

slides.title: Create a MAVLink mission
slides.html:
For step-by-step tasking, open the Add Task Menu (the +) and select Add.

  • Use the MISSION tab for the flight, FENCE for geofences, and RALLY for rally points.

slides.title: Add takeoff and waypoints
slides.html: Tap the Pencil Icon to add mission items to the map. Add Takeoff to arm and climb to an altitude, then add Waypoint points for the aircraft to fly to (speed, altitude, yaw, gimbal).

slides.title: Set ROI on a target
slides.html: Add ROI (Region of Interest) to lock the gimbal onto a point. Add Cancel ROI before the mission ends, or the aircraft keeps tracking the target in manual flight.

slides.title: Finish with Land or Return to Launch
slides.html: End the mission with Land to set a landing waypoint, or Return to Launch to fly back to takeoff and land. Tap Save to store the mission, then run it from the Onboard list.
